paragraphs: Rabbi Ivo said in Rabbi Yannai’s name, beginning of Af Al Pi 54b; Kiddushin 19a, 33, end of a; Zevachim 103a—another statement in his name [ד״א; reading provisional]. Ketubbot 104b: Rabbi Ivo said in Rabbi Yannai’s name. In Rabbi Chama bar Ukva’s name (see there); Rabbi Yose bar Chanina’s name, Pesachim 46a; Chullin 123a, see Rashi. In Rabbi Yose ben Zimra’s name. Rabbi Yudan and Rabbi Tavi in Rabbi Yoshiyah’s name. Rabbi Pinchas bar Chama; Rabbi Putriki, Rabbi Derosai’s brother, in his name.
